U: yeah let's not, this was a bad idea

Branch deleted, no commit landed on main.
</p1>

<compartment start="46" end="60" title="Standby-safe status writer" episode_type="design,infra,feature" importance="95">
<p1>
Did the deeper controller pass for WorkspaceMesh after finding that read-only standby replicas still had code paths that could mutate status during a race. The user constraint was explicit.
U: one cluster, many control planes; never let a standby write status.
U: deletes can lag, status can't lie.

In controllers/workspacemesh_controller.go I split reconcile into observe, plan, and commit stages. Observe and plan run before lease acquisition, so standby replicas can still do the expensive graph walk and diff calculation. Commit is now wrapped by pkg/lease/lease_guard.go and is the only place allowed to write status, finalizers, or child mutations. That let us keep fast reads without letting a standby fake health by racing the active leader. Commit c8b1e44.

I also changed api/v1alpha1/workspacemesh_types.go so status carries observedPlan, a stable hash of the rendered child set, and delayed finalizer removal until the ServiceExport cleanup confirms from the API server. Envtest coverage now exercises leader handoff, stale standby loops, and delete timing, because the real problem here was not feature behavior but truthful status under partial failover.
</p1>
<p2>
Reworked the WorkspaceMesh controller around a hard write boundary.
U: one cluster, many control planes; never let a standby write status.
U: deletes can lag, status can't lie.

controllers/workspacemesh_controller.go now separates observe, plan, and commit. Standbys may read and compute, but pkg/lease/lease_guard.go is required for any status or finalizer write. status.observedPlan was added so drift is visible without child diffs, and finalizer removal now waits for ServiceExport cleanup confirmation.
</p2>
<p3>
The durable decision was to allow standby replicas to do read-heavy reconcile work while centralizing every mutating step behind a lease-guarded commit boundary. Status truth won over delete speed.
</p3>
<p4>LeaseGuard; observe/plan/commit; status.observedPlan; finalizer waits for ServiceExport cleanup</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<PROJECT_RULES>
* Reconciler code may compute desired state before lease acquisition, but every status or finalizer write must pass through LeaseGuard.
* Any new cleanup step must be idempotent across repeated reconcile loops before it is attached to finalizer removal.
</PROJECT_RULES>
<ARCHITECTURE>
* The controller is split into observe, plan, and commit so standby replicas can do expensive reads without risking conflicting writes.
* Status carries an observedPlan hash so downstream tools can detect desired-versus-applied drift without diffing child resources.
</ARCHITECTURE>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* In a multi-control-plane cluster, standby reconciles can race with the active leader; unrestricted status writes make object health lie even when spec is unchanged.
</CONSTRAINTS>

</NAMING>

<compartment start="760" end="848" title="HLS segment numbering migration from 5-digit to 9-digit indices" episode_type="refactor,infra" importance="74">
<p1>
The transcoder's HLS output was using `segment_%05d.ts` — five digits, max 99,999 segments. For a 24/7 live channel at 6s segments that's ~7 days before wraparound, and we just hit a wraparound on `channel-news-east` Friday night that broke the playlist sliding window for ~40 minutes before paging on-call noticed.

Migrated to `segment_%09d.ts` everywhere. Touched `transcoder/hls/segmenter.go` for the writer, `transcoder/hls/playlist.go` for the manifest builder, and the CDN purge job's glob in `ops/purge-stale-segments.sh`. The CDN cache config didn't need changes — the glob was already `segment_*.ts`. Backfill is a no-op because old playlists naturally roll off the sliding window within an hour.

Codified in the writer: any future segment-index format change must keep monotonic ordering AND must always be lexicographically sortable. The 5-digit choice was actually fine lexicographically until wraparound — the failure mode was running out of namespace, not ordering.
</p1>
<p2>
HLS segment naming widened from `%05d` to `%09d` after a live-channel wraparound broke playlist sliding-window on `channel-news-east`. Changes in `transcoder/hls/segmenter.go` and `transcoder/hls/playlist.go`. Naming rule documented: segment indices must always be zero-padded to remain lexicographically sortable, with enough digits for a year of continuous segments at our minimum segment duration.
</p2>
<p3>
HLS segment indices widened after a live-channel index wraparound.
</p3>
<p4>
segment_%09d.ts; transcoder/hls/
</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* HLS segment filename format: `segment_%09d.ts` (writer in `transcoder/hls/segmenter.go`, manifest builder in `transcoder/hls/playlist.go`).
</CONFIG_VALUES>
<PROJECT_RULES>
* HLS segment indices must be zero-padded to a width sufficient for at least one year of continuous output at the minimum supported segment duration. Lexicographic sortability is required for CDN purge globbing.
</PROJECT_RULES>
</facts>

<causal_incident at_compartment="5">

  <cause_summary>5-digit segment index namespace exhausted on a continuously-running channel; new segments lexicographically sorted before old ones, breaking the manifest builder's ordering assumption.</cause_summary>
  <disposition>fixed</disposition>
  <evidence>On-call paged on viewer drop in channel-news-east; logs showed segment files alternating between `segment_99998.ts` and `segment_00000.ts` in the same directory.</evidence>
  <fix_summary>Widened format to `segment_%09d.ts` across writer, manifest builder, and CDN purge glob.</fix_summary>
</causal_incident>

<compartment start="56" end="92" title="回收四条实施道：M1/M2/媒体策略/M5 全部落地并通过独立红线复核" episode_type="feature,investigation" importance="68">
<p1>
本窗口四条实施道全部回收，B 包三大模块+媒体策略落地，我随后做了独立红线复核（grep 级，不采信 fixer 自报）。

**M1 道回收**：`web/identity/`（FaceIdentityResolver、ResolvedFaceIdentity、DevTestFaceIdentityResolver、IdentityProvidersConfig dev/test-only 而无 prod bean、MemberAccessGrantService 474 行、MemberAccessGrantController 211 行；MemberAccessGrantsIT 660+StorageFailureIT 82，共 12 IT）。流程：严格 multipart `{metadata,face}` 验证→JCS payloadHash（capture+consent+accountUuid+installationId+face digest）→`IdempotencyService.begin`→`MediaIntakeService.ingest(GRANT_FACE)`→回读→`FaceProvider.classify`→resolver→`members` 只读查找→业务事务。MATCHED+有成员：已有 active→200 同 grantId，否则 INSERT（`source_request_id=handle.requestId()`）→201；QUALITY_REJECTED→422；DEPENDENCY_FAILED→503；UNCERTAIN/RELIABLE_NEW/库中无成员→403 FACE_NOT_VERIFIED 同一非揭示消息。重放：active→200 replayed=true、revoked→403 GRANT_REVOKED、缺失→404。`uq_grant_active` DuplicateKeyException→回滚后恢复事务复读 active 行 completeSuccess→200（并发不 500）。begin 后确定的 4xx 用 completeRejected 记录，使同键重试重放原拒绝（比 lane 字面步骤更严但合 idempotency 语义）。A02 keyset 分页 `(account_id,status,created_at DESC,id DESC)` 对齐 `idx_grants_account_status_created`，游标绑定 accountId digest 拒跨账号游标，只返回 active、省略 memberSummary。A03 行锁仅 active 置 revoked（204 无体、无 Cache-Control），已撤销不再写、revoked_at 不变。404 两分支"字节一致"仅在掩掉每次必变的契约 requestId 后成立，测试如此断言。

我的独立红线复核结论：单表/无 JOIN（唯一写是 `INSERT INTO member_access_grants` 与字段级 `UPDATE media_objects SET member_id`）；`members` 零 INSERT/UPDATE（成员建档确属 D）；撤销不复活（MemberAccessGrantService:151 对已撤销行抛 GRANT_REVOKED 不新建）；存在性不泄漏（180/186/193 三分支同一 FACE_NOT_VERIFIED_MESSAGE）；`verification_summary` 仅入 INSERT 列绝不投影（响应恰为 `{grantId,memberId,status,grantedAt}` 四字段，与契约 additionalProperties:false 一致）；T13 外键满足；payloadHash 覆盖 capture 全字段+consentEvidenceRef+installationId+accountUuid（同键不同内容必然 409）。

**M2 道回收**：`web/devices/` 2096 主 + 1366 测试行、22 IT。心跳 epoch/seq 存 `gimbals.latest_observation` JSONB（observation_epoch、observation_seq JSON integer、schema_version:1、power_state、observed_at、received_at、task_ref、execution_ref、episodes）；不同 epoch=新来源会话接受并重置，同 epoch 仅严格更大 seq；拒绝/重复→200 accepted=false、不刷 last_seen_at、不 bump status_revision、不覆盖；`status_revision` 用 `WHERE id=? AND status_revision=<锁内读值>` 守卫，仅 unknown/offline→online +1，永不写 offline；last_seen_at 取服务器 now() 非客户端 observedAt。incidentId 服务端生成、active 期间复用、清除→resolved+resolved_at、再发生→新 id。A04 观察 Idempotency-Key 必需，顺序 auth→begin（重放短路）→ConnectionProofVerifier→业务事务→T04 定位/注册（savepoint 捕 DuplicateKeyException 复读），observer_* 取自认证主体绝不取 body；字段级 UPDATE 带 `AND observation_epoch IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ? AND observation_seq IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ?` 守卫；capabilities.schemaVersion→JSONB schema_version（JSON integer）。绑定 A06：revision 不符→409 BINDING_CHANGED（+details.currentBindingRevision 不含他账号数据）、他账号→409 BOUND_TO_OTHER、成功 guarded `binding_revision+1 RETURNING bound_at`；A08 解绑：行缺失 404 早于 revision 判断（防陈旧 If-Match 泄漏存在性）、陈旧→409、已解绑→204 不 bump、他账号→If-Match 符 409 否则 404 绝不删对方绑定；A07 三态+bindingRevision，缺 X-Pairing-Proof→400、其他非空 proof 失败→403。Proof doubles：DevProofCodec 格式 `d1.<b64url(payload)>.<b64url(HMAC-SHA256(devKey,payload))>`，payload={purpose,gimbalId,accountId,installationId,microcrystalSerial,observerType,observerRef,exp,nonce}，六种 fixture（valid/bad sig/expired/other gimbal/other account/nonce replay）+malformed+d2 版本；doubles 仅在 dev/test+providers.mode=doubles，`DeviceProofFailClosedValidator` 使生产缺非 double verifier 启动失败。**proof 验证在 T13 begin 之后**（重放短路先发生，同键同内容重放不因 nonce 消费失败），javadoc 明示。TASK_REPLACED 在 M2-A02 有意不用（taskId/executionId 仅观察写入 task_ref/execution_ref，不下发动作不移动指针）。`app.devices.*`（staleness-seconds=300、offline-seconds=300 预留 L4、incident-suppression-seconds=60 预留）联调起点未冻结。
